LANDING_DESCRIPTION: EcoDeli offers a new way to send and receive packages by leveraging crowdshipping: individuals deliver for others, during their journeys. An economical, ecological and human solution that promotes social ties and purchasing power. Beyond packages, EcoDeli also provides access to everyday services: shopping, journeys, transfers, occasional assistance... A platform designed to simplify life, together.
LANDING_PRIVATE_DESCRIPTION: Have your packages delivered or provide a service while you're on the go. Economical, supportive, and eco-friendly.
LANDING_DELIVRER_DESCRIPTION: Optimize your journeys by delivering packages or providing services. Simple, flexible, and profitable.
LANDING_PROVIDER_DESCRIPTION: Offer your daily services to a local community. Visibility, proximity, and additional income are guaranteed.
LANDING_MERCHANT_DESCRIPTION: Offer delivery to your customers without complex logistics. Gain visibility, build loyalty, and boost your local sales.
